note: Local rule book. Loaded into Senso by `npm run senso:load` when SENSO_API_KEY is set. Clauses marked verified were read on the source page on 2026-11-20. Unverified clauses are paraphrased and say so in the audit page.

policies.title: Guaranteed Delivery
policies.clause: If an order with a guaranteed delivery date arrives after the guaranteed date, Amazon refunds the shipping fees paid for the guaranteed option.
policies.verifiedNote: Paraphrased. Amazon's help page returned HTTP 503 during the build; check the source.

policies.title: Price Match Guarantee
policies.clause: If Best Buy lowers its own price on an item during the return and exchange period, Best Buy will match that lower price and refund the difference.
policies.verifiedNote: Paraphrased. The Best Buy help URL we tried returned HTTP 404; check the source.

policies.title: Price Match: Costco.com Orders
policies.clause: Purchases that reduce in price within 30 days of the date of purchase are eligible for a price match.
policies.verifiedNote: Verbatim from Costco customer service document CU1491.

policies.title: Price Match Guarantee
policies.clause: Price matches may be requested at time of purchase or within 14 days after purchase.
policies.verifiedNote: Verbatim from Target's price match policy. Target also runs a holiday window (Nov 1 to Dec 24, 2026) that this demo does not apply.

policies.title: On-Time Window Promise
policies.clause: If your groceries arrive more than 30 minutes after the end of your delivery window, we credit $3.00 to your account.
policies.verifiedNote: Fictional merchant created for this demo.
